Complete guide to the Red-Maned Lynel in Tears of the Kingdom: a beginner-friendly boss with 2,000 HP. Covers every step of the headshot-and-mount strategy, creating kneeling openings with parries, and dodging the triple fireball attack — ideal for new players and those with weaker gear.

寻找射击时机（让它跪地） 拉开一点距离，在人马准备向你冲锋或吐火球的间隙，用弓箭瞄准它的脸部（胡子到嘴巴附近的位置）射击。 如果听到「叮」的清脆暴击声，人马会双手撑地，陷入几秒钟的瘫痪（跪地）状态。

Find your shot (make it kneel). Keep a little distance, and in the gap as the Lynel prepares to charge or spit fireballs, shoot it in the face with your bow (around the beard and mouth). If you hear a crisp "ding" critical-hit sound, the Lynel will brace itself on its hands and fall into a few seconds of paralysis (kneeling).

三连挥刀 / 蓄力横扫
前兆：人马举刀向你连续挥击。 应对：在它挥刀的瞬间，按住 ZL 锁定，同时向后跳（后翻滚）。如果时机准确，会触发「林克时间」，直接上去用单手剑或双手剑疯狂乱舞。

Tell: the Lynel raises its blade and slashes at you repeatedly. Counter: the instant it swings, hold ZL to lock on and jump backward (backflip). With good timing, this triggers a Flurry Rush — then rush in and flail away with a one-handed or two-handed sword.

前兆：它收起武器，像一匹真正的马一样四脚着地向你全速冲来。 方案 A（闪避流）：在它快撞到你的瞬间，向左或向右侧跳，可以触发林克时间，然后输出。 方案 B · 盾反（更推荐）：举盾迎着它，在它撞到你的瞬间按下 A 键进行盾反。盾反成功后它会原地愣神 1～2 秒，此时距离极近，直接拉弓盲射它的脸，它就会跪地。然后直接转入骑乘流。

Tell: it puts its weapon away and charges at you at full speed on all fours, like a real horse. Option A (dodge style): sidestep left or right the instant before it hits you to trigger bullet time, then attack. Option B · Perfect Guard (recommended): raise your shield to meet it and press A the instant it hits you to Perfect Guard. After a successful Perfect Guard it stands stunned for 1–2 seconds; at such close range, draw your bow and blind-fire at its face and it will kneel. Then go straight into the mounting strategy.

前兆：它拉开距离，连续向你吐出三个火球。 最省力办法：绕着人马做大半径的横向奔跑，火球绝对砸不到你。 反击时机：等它吐完第三个火球时，它会有短暂的收招硬直。此时可以气定神闲地停下来，拉弓瞄准它的脸射击，使其跪地，然后冲过去骑乘。

Tell: it backs away and spits three fireballs at you in a row. Easiest counter: run sideways around the Lynel in a wide circle — the fireballs absolutely cannot hit you. Counterattack window: after it spits the third fireball, it has a brief recovery stagger. Calmly stop, draw your bow, aim at its face, make it kneel, then rush over and mount.
